# Motivation

## Where should Condominios de Viviendas Tuteladas be prioritized?

The IPT-CVT was developed to identify territorial differences in the conditions that shape the priority for the construction of Condominios de Viviendas Tuteladas.

The index brings together demographic, social, territorial, institutional and environmental information into a single territorial prioritization framework.
